desc:
Welcome to Superhero Universe!

How to Play:
🦸 Pick a hero and explore the city
🕸️ Swing, fly, run and smash your way around
🚨 Stop crimes, robberies and city disasters
💰 Earn cash to unlock new heroes and gold suits
⬆️ Upgrade your hero's power, speed and armor
🚁 Cause chaos and take on the cops

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players

"The BEST Superhero game on Roblox." - Papa Bee
